When input.held_buttons[0] mask 0x200 is absent, requests ftPr_MS_SpecialAirNChargeRelease with motion flags 0x41092, the current animation frame, and zero animation-rate and blend arguments. The guard is a held-mask level test, not an explicit release-edge detector.
